title: Lemma 3.2, Lemma 3.3 and Theorem 3.8
statement: (Lemma 3.2) If A ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} equals ⋃ⱼ Aⱼ with Hⁿ(Aⱼ) < ∞, then A = R ∪ P with R, P disjoint, R countably n-rectifiable and P purely n-unrectifiable, and if A is Hⁿ-measurable, R can be chosen Borel. (Lemma 3.3) If S ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} satisfies Hⁿ(coordinateProjection J (S)) = 0 for every J ⊆ Fin (n+ℓ) with #J = n, then S is purely n-unrectifiable. (Theorem 3.8) If A = ⋃ⱼ Aⱼ with Hⁿ(Aⱼ) < ∞ and every B ⊆ A with Hⁿ(B) > 0 satisfies ¬ForAlmostAllProjections (n+ℓ) n (fun p ↦ Hⁿ(p(B)) = 0), then A is countably n-rectifiable.
